## Checklist

<!-- Check all that apply before requesting review -->

- [ ] Tests pass: `python -m pytest packages/ --tb=short -q`
- [ ] Lint passes: `ruff check . && ruff format --check .`

- [ ] If spec change: valid + invalid fixtures added to `/spec/tests/`
- [ ] If new feature: conformance tests written
- [ ] If adapter change: adapter tests pass
- [ ] STATUS.md updated (if applicable)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, keys, or credentials
